title: Nourishing Arabian Lamb Grill
description: A cultured, crisp post-workout Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb leg grilled on a raclette grill with fresh vegetables and aromatic spices.
instructions: In a bowl, combine lamb pieces with rosemary, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, and salt; let marinate for 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
While the lamb marinates, heat the raclette grill on high until it reaches a crisp surface temperature.
Arrange baby carrots, sliced zucchini, and red onion on a separate platter and drizzle them with a teaspoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Place the marinated lamb on the heated grill and sear each side for 4 minutes until a golden crust forms.
After searing, transfer the lamb to a plate and allow it to rest for 5 minutes to retain juices.
Using the same raclette grill, gently grill the vegetables for 3 minutes per side, turning occasionally, until they are tender yet still crisp.
Once grilled, arrange the lamb slices on a serving platter with the roasted vegetables.
Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh rosemary leaves for an aromatic finish.
Serve immediately while hot, pairing with a light cucumber yogurt dip if desired.
